document.title: PER-2/PJ/2024: Bentuk bukti potong dan SPT Masa PPh 21/26

delta.note: PER-2/PJ/2024 only governs the form and procedure for creating PPh 21/26 withholding slips (bukti potong 1721-VI, VII, VIII, A1) and the content, filling and submission of the monthly SPT Masa PPh 21/26. It is purely administrative and reporting in nature. It does not change any rate, PTKP, TER table, deduction, rounding, or calculation step for permanent employees, so it is not relevant to the PPh 21 computation.
